args.title: Saltmarsh Foods Newsletter: Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
• Newsletter (Saltmarsh Foods): This week's edition covers retail returns logistics, linking to the main article at blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns.
• Main article: Apparel return rates have reached 24%, and consolidating return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (20%).
• Companion piece: Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
